title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Time for a break, Doctor. Just how long have you been sitting at a table like that? Get up and go stretch out a little. Yes, I mean now.

title: Talk 1
original: It is my duty to perform regular check-ups on Oripathy patients. Some are personable enough, but a few are hard to communicate with. It's not the first time, though, so worry not, they will understand how vital a doctor is to them.

title: Talk 2
original: You know what an amnesia patient should pay attention to, Doctor? Don't work yourself into the ground. Work and relaxation are equally important!

title: Talk 3
original: You always have patients who ignore the doctor's orders, but in battle, you don't see a doctor who'd miss a single cry for help.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: The advancement of medicine is a lesson taught by none other than the cruelty of war and disasters, a lesson we medical workers learn through pain and suffering... But... It's a fact I figured out long ago. As long as I can help my patients get their lives back, I'm ready to face the fact.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Together we've spent some... uh, I mean, some most memorable moments! Come on, you know I'm not good at this, Doctor. And next time I see you put up that teasing face, I'd be real mad!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Here's a pen. How did I know you wanted it? Well, I've been working with you for a while now, isn't it natural I picked up on it?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I'm still far below the level of Silence and Shining, but that doesn't mean I can't overcome an obstacle when I see one before me. Otherwise, how can I measure up to your confidence in me?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: The sun's good on the deck, and the wind's just fine… Mm? No, I'm not slacking off. It's just... I'm feeling swamped right now, like you occasionally do, Doctor. So, anything bothering you? Mm-hm, keep it as a whisper if it's easier for you this way. I'm listening.

title: Idle
original: Who came up with this meal plan? I'm having spasms in my stomach just by looking at the list!

title: Onboard
original: Sussurro, Medic, reporting in with a little reminder for the Doctor. Now, I understand you have a lot on your plate, and even if they say a 'doctor' makes the worst patient, you need to follow our advice.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I must make more copies of these battle notes for Myrrh and company.

title: Promotion 1
original: Promotion ceremony, while everyone stares at me? I don't have to make any embarrassing speeches, do I? No, no, I'm not nervous at all, really...

title: Promotion 2
original: For this promotion, I have the entire Medical Department to thank, who's been supporting me all the time with their hard work. And of course, thank you too, Doctor, for your guidance. I'm very, very grateful to you all!

title: Added to Squad
original: Don't worry, I'll watch over them.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Hold everything! You must complete all pre-battle physical exams to deploy!

title: Depart
original: Attention, medics, make sure to follow all standard procedures in battle. Now, to your positions.

title: Begin Operation
original: Safety first, and do not touch anything that may be suspicious or infected!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I'm over here!

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Speak louder! It's hard to hear over the battle!

title: Deployment 1
original: Medic's here! Here!

title: Deployment 2
original: Anybody hurt?

title: In Battle 1
original: Don't worry, you'll be okay in no time!

title: In Battle 2
original: Don't concern yourself with fighting, you're still wounded!

title: In Battle 3
original: Listen to the doctor!

title: In Battle 4
original: Scream if you're in pain, don't hold it in!

title: 4-star Result
original: Finally, the battle's over. You should take a break too. I imagine commanding the mission would take a toll on your body.

title: 3-star Result
original: No casualty on our side. The Doctor's leadership is indeed unparalleled.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Will the enemy return? There are still wounded unable to move here.

title: Operation Failure
original: Make way, make way! Stop crowding! Wounded coming through!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Promise you'll rest when it's time to, okay?

title: Tap
original: Um…

title: Trust Tap
original: Phew. I need a drink after work! Mind handing me a juice, Doctor? Thanks!

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Doctor. New Year's is a time for proper relaxation, and you can't overstress yourself. I know you'll be at the dining table soon, though, and you can't let yourself go too much. I remember how bad your indigestion was after you overate last year. I'll keep an eye on you this time!

title: Greeting
original: How do you do, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, happy birthday. I made you a cylinder cake—they seem popular lately. You don't need to hide it, I figured you'd be rolling in cakes today long beforehand... Anyway, don't eat too much, whatever you do! Watch your sugar intake!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I don't know how much longer life will carry on like this. Sometimes I even feel like I can't make out the future ahead, but if it even gets to us medics, how much worse must it be for our patients, waiting for us to treat them? I'm sure we'll see the light of dawn one day, Doctor.
